value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is the canonical minimal four-regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph. Its full integral matching-complex homotopy classification exposes a genuine odd-torsion Moore summand and quantifies 28 non-torsion spheres, separating it from matching-complex sphere-wedge graph families. The example is a motivated natural graph-specific invariant, not an arbitrary slice or infinite-family assertion.
